input.question: Which educational institution did Yosuke Komatsu attend?

documents.text:
Yosuke Komatsu

Yosuke Komatsu is a renowned researcher in the field of interdisciplinary sciences, known for his groundbreaking contributions to the understanding of complex systems and their applications. Early Life and Education

Komatsu was born on February 12, 1985, in Tokyo, Japan. He developed an interest in science and mathematics at a young age, which led him to pursue higher education in the field. In 2003, Komatsu enrolled in the University of Kalyani Faculty of Science, where he completed his undergraduate degree in Physics with honors. Studies at University of Kalyani Faculty of Science

Komatsu's time at the University of Kalyani Faculty of Science was marked by his exceptional academic performance and research prowess. During his undergraduate studies, he worked under the guidance of Dr. S.K. Chakraborty, a distinguished professor of physics, on a project titled "Quantum Fluctuations in Non-Equilibrium Systems." This project laid the foundation for Komatsu's future research endeavors and earned him the prestigious "Best Undergraduate Researcher" award in 2007. In an interview with the University of Kalyani's alumni magazine, Komatsu credited the faculty's emphasis on interdisciplinary approaches and collaborative learning for shaping his research perspective. He stated, "The University of Kalyani Faculty of Science provided me with a unique environment that fostered my curiosity and encouraged me to explore the boundaries of traditional disciplines."
